candidates.requirement: Enable built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE receipt and advertise SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so valid client frames can reach the receive handler.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a server session, submits SETTINGS, sends, then passes input to nghttp2_session_mem_recv.
candidates.failure_condition: The null option leaves builtin_recv_ext_types zero, so the receive switch discards every PRIORITY_UPDATE payload. The submitted SETTINGS also changes pending_no_rfc7540_priorities from UINT8_MAX to 0, which independently blocks processing.
candidates.alternative_paths: Input can change remote settings but cannot set the local built-in mask or pending local setting. The user-extension route is also unset, and the target has no other session or call sequence.

candidates.requirement: Advertise SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so valid request Priority headers can set and apply extensible stream priority.
candidates.target_route: The server receives HEADERS bytes, inflates request headers, dispatches Priority to http_request_on_header, then finishes the header block.
candidates.failure_condition: The target submits only SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS. Its pending_no_rfc7540_priorities becomes 0, so new streams lack NGHTTP2_STREAM_FLAG_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES; the Priority header branch and subsequent priority application cannot run.
candidates.alternative_paths: Peer SETTINGS modify remote settings, not this local pending setting. The target has no other local SETTINGS submission or session setup; ordinary PRIORITY frames implement a different priority contract.

candidates.requirement: After nghttp2_session_mem_recv returns a fatal error, call only nghttp2_session_del on that session.
candidates.target_route: The server session begins by reading client magic; a mismatching first input byte makes mem_recv return NGHTTP2_ERR_BAD_CLIENT_MAGIC, after which the entry unconditionally calls send_pending.
candidates.failure_condition: send_pending calls nghttp2_session_mem_send on a session for which the fatal-error contract permits only deallocation.
candidates.alternative_paths: The input controls the first byte. The entry has no error check or conditional path between mem_recv and send_pending.
